notes.summary: The false extended-valued flattening lemma remains excluded. Direct single-net and actual-ample arguments repair the fixed-divisor cone; divided FS quotients need not decrease.
notes.detailedSummary: For smooth projective Y over any algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, the reconstruction uses one defining numerical FS net and the actual-ample G0 grant. It proves rational rounding, fixed-ample embeddings, finite-polytope homogeneous projection, homogeneous decomposition, literal divisor division, and compactness of nonmonotone quotients. For actual B=A+D, with A ample and D effective, it obtains the all-point identity {v numerical B-psh: v<=sigma_D+C for some C}=sigma_D+PSH(Y,A). This repairs cone foundations, not the required original local operator.
notes.text:
The proof reconstruction is in P16.2-paper.md, Sections 2 and 5, with P16.2-paper.tex and P16.2-paper.pdf. Run python3 rerun.py. Exact source scopes and retained literal passages are recorded in external-premises.json and evidence/units-index.json.

The supplied general BJ Lemma 4.6 counterexample is preserved and reconstructed. Let K be an isolated q plus p_j converging to p_infinity. The family F_a consists of functions with value c at q, minus infinity at p_a, and c-m elsewhere, for positive integer m and real c. These functions are extended-continuous, and each family is stable under constants. For each fixed a, increasing m gives the same limit g: zero at q and minus infinity elsewhere. Thus g belongs to every limiting family with parameter 1/a. However, a decreasing original-family net cannot change its label after a term from F_a: every later value at p_a must remain minus infinity, which only F_a permits. Its parameters cannot tend to zero. The general flattening lemma is therefore false. This does not disprove the equation theorem.

Safe fixed-ample flattening uses finite continuous inner FS functions. A sufficiently small positive shift of the limiting function lies strictly below two finite upper approximants, including at limiting poles. Compactness of the increasing negative open sets supplies a common inner index. This argument is performed before adding the common polar section.

Rational rounding within a single defining net instead uses non-strict inequalities. Round coefficients upward to obtain phi_i<=f_i,delta<=phi_i+delta, then put g_i,delta=f_i,delta+delta. Ordering by increasing i and decreasing g gives a directed net: choose a common later i and 2delta_new<=min(delta_old). These inequalities remain valid at common poles, and the resulting net preserves both the function limit and numerical-class convergence.

For rational lambda_j with max lambda_j>=0, homogeneous projection uses
inf_{r>=0} max_j(x_j+r lambda_j)=max_w sum_j w_j x_j,
where w ranges over vertices of {w>=0, sum w=1, sum w_j lambda_j>=0}. The vertices are nonnegative-slope unit vectors and rational zero-slope mixtures of two opposite slopes. One-dimensional breakpoint convexity proves equality. Finite floors of minus-infinity coordinates and commuting infima prove the extended-valued case. Clearing denominators produces actual section monomials in the same rational bundle. Supporting lines along each scaling ray then prove the all-point homogeneous decomposition.

For homogeneous h<=sigma_D, compactness of {sigma_D=-1} gives actual homogeneous FS approximants h_i<=t_i sigma_D, with t_i tending to one. Prime-divisor orders permit literal global section division by the corresponding power of the divisor section; normality justifies extension of the quotients. Their numerical classes tend to A. Small ample corrections realize their normalized quotients in one actual ample A cone. They need not decrease: normalized ample compactness supplies a subnet, and explicit divisorial convergence identifies its quotient. Divisorial determination in a common actual ample cone gives equality at every analytic point. Homogeneous decomposition and the ample envelope property give the entire reference-dominated cone.

The failure of quotient monotonicity is explicit on P1: h_i=(1-i^-2)sigma decreases, and t_i=1-i^-1 increases, but h_i-t_i sigma=(i^-1-i^-2)sigma increases wherever sigma<0. Compactness, rather than an asserted decreasing quotient net, is essential.

The exact-arithmetic diagnostic matched 5,616 three-branch homogeneous-projection cases, including minus-infinity coordinates. This finite grid is implementation evidence only. The general argument is mathematical, and remains an unverified draft relative to G0.

notes.summary: Retained polar data and genuine original-section metrics are reconstructed for every smooth integral proper carrier and every actual big rational L, including whole bad-fiber saturation and arbitrary field cardinality.
notes.detailedSummary: Chow and the exact characteristic-zero Temkin theorem produce a smooth projective modification. Actual section descent over normal X supplies big original Cartier bundles and polar presentations for every specified big rational L. Antiample fiber restrictions force every whole bad geometric fiber into D. Compatible valuative centers give canonical original metrics; multiplying finite fixed-A section nets by the divisor section gives genuine decreasing original-L section approximations at every point. The reference-dominated original section cone is bijective and divisorially homeomorphic to the genuine ample cone. Choices remain retained.
notes.text:
P16.2-paper.md, Sections 3–6, contains the standalone draft arguments; P16.2-paper.tex and P16.2-paper.pdf provide the rendered versions. Run python3 rerun.py. The external-premise ledger records exact retained hypotheses, literal passages, and limits of the source audit.

Fix any algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field k, of arbitrary cardinality, and any smooth integral proper X of dimension n>0. Chow gives an integral projective birational refinement. Temkin v2 Theorem 1.2.1 applies because that refinement is Noetherian, quasi-excellent, generically reduced, and over Spec Q; finite type over Q is not required. Its finite blowup sequence remains integral and projective. The regular final Y is smooth over perfect k. For pi:Y->X, the normal-base theorem gives pi_*O_Y=O_X, and local frame gluing gives the actual pullback identity H0(Y,p pi*L)=H0(X,pL).

Big actual original bundles exist. Choose a very ample effective hyperplane H on Y avoiding the finitely many exceptional prime divisors. Its pushforward B is Cartier because smooth X is locally factorial. Then pi*B=H+E with effective exceptional E. Multiplication by the divisor section injects H0(Y,mH) into H0(X,mB), proving positive degree-n section growth.

For any specified big rational L, clear denominators to F=q pi*L. Choose a very ample M and a hyperplane T in its linear system. T need not be reduced. On T choose ample N with N-F|T globally generated, and a section avoiding all associated points. Its powers inject F^m|T into N^m. Serre vanishing and the coherent Euler polynomial yield h0(T,F^m|T)=O(m^(n-1)). The restriction sequence therefore gives h0(Y,mF-M)>=h0(Y,mF)-O(m^(n-1)). Bigness supplies a nonzero section for some m, yielding pi*L=A+D with A=M/(qm) actual ample rational and D effective rational. The actual line-bundle isomorphism and modification are retained before any target is chosen. No independence from these choices or identification with unrestricted class volume is claimed.

Let U be the isomorphism locus of pi. The normal-base quasi-finite birational theorem excludes zero-dimensional components in every bad geometric fiber. On each positive-dimensional integral reduced fiber component, pi*L is trivial, so D restricts to -A. A nonzero antiample section would inject unbounded ample section growth into the finite space H0(O), which is impossible. Thus the canonical divisor section vanishes on every component of every bad fiber. With P=pi(|D|), this proves pi^-1(P)=|D| and Y minus |D| is isomorphic to X minus P. Saturation concerns whole fibers, not only exceptional divisors.

Proper valuation-ring centers and uniqueness give compatible canonical trivial metrics on the actual original bundles. Compact center domains and analytic surjectivity give closed quotient descent without metrizability assumptions. For genuine A-psh psi, sigma_D+psi is constant on every analytic fiber: minus infinity on fibers over P, and a unique value on all other singleton fibers. It descends to an actual usc original metric F(psi), with its prescribed value at every point.

Take one finite fixed-A FS net decreasing to psi. Clear degrees and multiply every section by the actual canonical divisor section. Actual section descent gives original L sections, with identical pulled logarithmic norm formulas and constants. Their maxima decrease to F(psi) at every analytic point, including common poles. With tau=F(0), n1 proves that the original section cone dominated by tau+C is exactly F(PSH(Y,A)). Divisorial order cancellation gives its unique genuine quotient Q, normalized compactness, and finite energy E_M(u)=E_A(Q(u)).

A classical Miyake–Oda fan supplies a genuinely nonprojective test over every retained field. Its ten maximal charts are unimodular affine three-spaces. Complete-fan properness follows from the retained DVR character-extension proof. Three wall degrees are a1+a6-a2-a5, a2+a7-a3-a6, and a3+a5-a1-a7; they sum to zero, excluding an ample original bundle. The test is not a restriction of the whole-domain construction. Genuine local operator identification remains separate.

notes.detailedSummary: Before selecting targets, genuine ample mixed products define positive raw Radon pairings on the original carrier. A reconstructed finite-energy pole proves zero exceptional mass. Original fiber-max relative potentials give an intrinsic dual-energy condition equivalent to integrability of every finite-energy relative potential. Unique zero-exceptional Radon inversion gives attainment, comparison, and uniqueness modulo constants. Minorant and all-original-continuous-majorant energies agree and have both derivative signs. Divided global-section products converge to bounded discontinuous endpoints and admit relative-floor mixed and integrable weighted extensions. Agreement with the exact actual-ample local contact/collar construction under the local bundle isometry remains unproved; candidate=false.
notes.text:
The deliverable is P16.2-paper.md, P16.2-paper.tex, and the compiled 16-page P16.2-paper.pdf. Companion files include status.json, external-premises.json, notes.json, verification.json, commands.json, environment.json, and artifact-manifest.json. Run python3 rerun.py. The run passed preservation and schema checks, retained 18 supplied blocks and 124 literal primary units, generated 22 premise records, and completed both XeLaTeX passes without the checked layout or missing-character warnings. These checks and hashes are not mathematical certification.

For the datum and genuine quotient Q of n2, construct the pairing before choosing any target:
M_tilde(u1,...,un)=p_*M_A(Q(u1),...,Q(un)).
It is positive, symmetric, Radon, and has exact raw mass V=A^n. To establish zero exceptional mass, choose a normalized A-section logarithm a vanishing along D and set w=1-(1-a)^(1/(n+2)). Convex slopes in [0,1] give genuine ample membership. Signed integration by parts proves Cap{a<=-s}<=n/s. Strict locality, fixed masses, and mixed positivity give
J(max(z,-s))<=1+integral_1^infinity t^n Cap{z<=-t}dt.
The factor t^n is essential. For w the integrand is O(t^-2), so w is genuinely finite energy and equals minus infinity on all D. Every mixed ample finite-energy product integrates w, hence gives D zero mass. This is proved before target selection.

Define q_u(x)=max_{p(y)=x}Q(u)(y). Compact fibers give attainment, and closed images of superlevel sets prove upper semicontinuity. Off P it equals u-tau; on P it is a specified retained relative value, never a subtraction of two infinities. For mass-V positive Radon mu define
D_M(mu)=sup_{u in E1_M}(E_M(u)-integral q_u dmu).
Finiteness forces every q_u integrable; q_F(w) then forces mu(P)=0. A positive-functional construction using the inverse isomorphism off P produces the unique Radon inverse nu with zero D mass. Compact bump functions prove that assertion and weak lifting continuity. Consequently D_M(mu)=E_A^vee(nu), and G0 proves finiteness exactly when every finite-energy q_u is integrable. There is no imposed skeletal support or arbitrary choice in a bad fiber.

For every original f in C(Xan), divisorial cancellation and actual-ample usc determination give F(eta)<=u+t f if and only if eta<=Q(u)+t p*f. The genuine-minorant energy is therefore E_A(P_A(Q(u)+t p*f)). Its infimum over all original continuous relative majorants q_u+t f<=b is the same: decreasing all such b, ample envelope continuity, and singleton divisorial fibers determine the identical limit. Both derivative signs give the raw integral of f against M_tilde. G0 attainment and actual section descent produce an attained original finite-energy maximizer. Both derivative signs yield its pairing equation M_tilde(u)=mu. Radon inversion and G0 give uniqueness modulo one constant; comparison transports on strict sets outside P. These statements concern the pairing and remain conditional as a complete genuine local Monge–Ampère theory.

Local progress is stronger than uniform continuous convergence. Off P, compatible frames give the literal raw weight lambda=psi+h_A+log|f_D|, with a plus unit logarithm. Finite actual original-section products agree with finite ample local products. For finite fixed-A nets decreasing globally to bounded genuine psi, G0 proves convergence on compact original frame neighborhoods even when the endpoint is discontinuous. Germ independence holds within this divided global-section category, and finite-stage analytic-unit identities pass through its decreasing limits. The relative floors max(u,tau-j) correspond to max(psi,-j). Mixed locality and finite-energy integrability recover their unbounded nonpluripolar restrictions and integrable weighted limits with mass V.

The exact remaining statement L is to identify these products with the required actual local construction for these same metrics: bounded, possibly discontinuous local contact/collar products must agree with the divided global-section limits, independently of the required approximants, compatible frames, and collar realizations; their integrable weighted and relative-floor finite-energy extensions must also agree. Division by the nonvanishing polar section maps e_L to the actual ample frame e_A/f_D isometrically. A direct audit of G0's local construction in that frame could avoid globalization of local contact families, which need not be globally decreasing fixed-A nets. Neither route is completed here. Uniform convergence for continuous endpoints does not establish the missing statement.

The collar reference identity must retain Phi=p+Psi/a and lambda=a Phi+a h0+M+1. Omitting p, or claiming a maximum containing a zero branch has a negative value, is invalid. No arbitrary-local-psh theorem or independence from the retained datum is introduced as an additional gate. No counterexample to L or P16.2 is claimed. The complete original task remains unproved, so candidate=false.
